settings.model: pre-norm decoder-only transformer: token embedding + learned positions, n_l blocks (causal multi-head self-attention, GELU FFN), final LayerNorm, output layer; dropout on embeddings and sublayer outputs; GPT-2 init (normal 0.02)
settings.evaluation: overlapping windows of T_max = 128 with stride 64; only the second half of each window is scored, so every character has 65 to 128 characters of context
settings.trained_on: train (1,000,000 characters), random windows of 128 characters
settings.scored: every character of the split (60,394 on test), each once; context from the text immediately before the split
settings.train_loop: AdamW(betas=(0.9, 0.99), weight_decay=0.01), linear warm-up over 100 steps, cosine decay to 10% of the peak, gradient-norm clipping at 1.0, cross-entropy (teacher forcing)
settings.mode: full (the configuration designed for a T4), executed on CPU
settings.train_seconds_note: measured on the CPU named in environment.lab05, under contention; not a T4 time

settings.model: Lab 1 pipeline (lab01.tfidf_logreg settings) with C = 1, recomputed in Lab 11
settings.bins: 15 equal-width right-closed bins ((m-1)/M, m/M], 0 in the first; equal-mass for ece_15_equal_mass
settings.brier: multiclass, sum over the 4 classes, mean over examples (range 0 to 2)
settings.temperature: tau fitted on val (600) by minimizing log loss over log tau in [-3, 3] (scipy minimize_scalar, bounded); *_after metrics on test at tau_star
settings.noise_floor: mean ECE over 2,000 draws of outcomes ~ Bernoulli(test confidences), seed 0
settings.selective: act when confidence >= lambda; Chow lambda* = 1 - l_defer / l_wrong; val-chosen lambda minimizes the empirical cost on val, smallest on ties; risk null when nothing is acted on
